event_summary: A dark corrugated tabletop structure has multiple flickering flames that change size and shape while it rests on a tan sheet on a wooden table.
raw_event_description: The clip begins with an already ongoing fire on a small folded, ribbed structure placed on a tan rectangular sheet. Bright yellow, orange, and white flames are visible on the left, center, upper, and right portions of the structure. Over time the flames repeatedly lengthen, narrow, bend, split, and shrink; the right-side flame is initially tall and bright, later becoming lower and closer to the right curved edge, while the left and central flames continue flickering. The structure stays in the same tabletop position, with dark and orange glowing areas visible along parts of it. The camera view remains essentially unchanged.

reasons: The first frame already shows visible flames on the object.
The burning object, tan sheet, and wooden tabletop are clearly visible.
The start of ignition is not shown.
